title: Baked Ziti

tags: [Vegetarian]
---

A comforting baked pasta with a simple simmered tomato sauce, creamy ricotta, and melted mozzarella and parmesan on top.

## Ingredients

### Sauce

| Ingredient | Quantity |
|:-:|:-:|
| Crushed tomatoes | One 28oz can |
| Olive oil | 3 tbsp |
| Garlic, minced | 4 cloves |
| Red pepper flakes | 1/2 tsp |

### Assembly

| Ingredient | Quantity |
|:-:|:-:|
| Ziti | 1 lb |
| Whole milk ricotta | 15 oz |
| Low-moisture mozzarella, shredded | 2 cups |
| Parmesan, grated | 1/2 cup |

## Instructions

### Sauce
1. Warm the oil, garlic and pepper flakes until fragrant.
2. Add the tomatoes and simmer 20 minutes.

### Assembly
1. Boil the ziti two minutes shy of al dente.
2. Fold the pasta with the sauce and ricotta.
3. Layer into a dish, top with mozzarella and parmesan.
4. Bake at 400F for 25 minutes.
